# Lending Policy 2026 Strategy Update

This document details the necessary actions for the 2026 lending strategy:

*   Update the interest rates for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the default risk for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the collateral value urgently.
*   Review the collateral value for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the borrower credit score urgently.
